.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"

VCLK clk 0 PULSE(0 3.3 50n 100p 100p 39.9n 100n)
VWL wl 0 PULSE(3.3 0 20n 100p 100p 379.9n 400n)

VSL0 sl0 0 PWL(0 0.0 99.5n 0.0 100.5n 3.3 199.5n 3.3 200.5n 0.0 299.5n 0.0 300.5n 3.3 399.5n 3.3 400.5n 0.0 499.5n 0.0 500.5n 3.3 599.5n 3.3 600.5n 0.0 699.5n 0.0 700.5n 3.3 799.5n 3.3 800.5n 0.0 899.5n 0.0 900.5n 3.3 999.5n 3.3 1000.5n 0.0 1099.5n 0.0 1100.5n 3.3 1199.5n 3.3 1200.5n 0.0 1299.5n 0.0 1300.5n 3.3 1399.5n 3.3 1400.5n 0.0 1499.5n 0.0 1500.5n 3.3 1600n 3.3)
VBL1 bl1 0 PWL(0 0.0 399.5n 0.0 400.5n 0.0 799.5n 0.0 800.5n 3.3 1199.5n 3.3 1200.5n 3.3 1600n 3.3)

VSL1 sl1 0 PWL(0 0.0 99.5n 0.0 100.5n 0.0 199.5n 0.0 200.5n 3.3 299.5n 3.3 300.5n 3.3 399.5n 3.3 400.5n 0.0 499.5n 0.0 500.5n 0.0 599.5n 0.0 600.5n 3.3 699.5n 3.3 700.5n 3.3 799.5n 3.3 800.5n 0.0 899.5n 0.0 900.5n 0.0 999.5n 0.0 1000.5n 3.3 1099.5n 3.3 1100.5n 3.3 1199.5n 3.3 1200.5n 0.0 1299.5n 0.0 1300.5n 0.0 1399.5n 0.0 1400.5n 3.3 1499.5n 3.3 1500.5n 3.3 1600n 3.3)

.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5

* @spec lookup1 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V

meas tran lookup0 FIND v(miss) AT=75n

meas tran lookup13 FIND v(miss) AT=1375n
meas tran lookup14 FIND v(miss) AT=1475n
meas tran lookup15 FIND v(miss) AT=1575n
meas tran store0b0 FIND v(q0) AT=30n
meas tran store0b1 FIND v(q1) AT=30n
meas tran store1b0 FIND v(q0) AT=430n
meas tran store1b1 FIND v(q1) AT=430n
meas tran store2b0 FIND v(q0) AT=830n
meas tran store2b1 FIND v(q1) AT=830n
meas tran store3b0 FIND v(q0) AT=1230n
meas tran store3b1 FIND v(q1) AT=1230n
write out.raw v(miss) v(xdut.ml) v(q0) v(q1) v(clk)
quit
.endc
.end
